title: Correct EMF formula
description: Essential: Student must apply the formula for effective EMF in a rotating coil: E = NBSω/√2.

title: Correct EMF calculation
description: Essential: Student must compute the numerical value of E correctly, obtaining approximately 6.4 × 10² V.

title: Output voltage relationship
description: Important: Student must recognize that output voltage U equals induced EMF minus internal voltage drop: U = E - Ir.

title: Output power formula
description: Important: Student must correctly apply the power formula P = IU or its equivalent P = I(E - Ir).

title: Correct power calculation
description: Essential: Student must compute the numerical value of P correctly, obtaining approximately 3.1 × 10⁴ W.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent SI units throughout the calculation and includes correct units in final answers.

title: Confusing peak with effective
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses peak EMF (NBSω) instead of effective value, forgetting the √2 factor.

title: Sign error in voltage drop
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly writes U = E + Ir, adding instead of subtracting the internal voltage drop.
